title: TUI integration edit: restore the kind slot when switching back to the original kind
description: In the integration edit dense form, changing the kind clears the kind slot (base URL / command / MCP URL) so an old value is never sent under the wrong flag (v1.16.0). Switching back to the original kind leaves the slot empty instead of restoring the stored value; the operator must re-open the row and retype it. Fix: remember the stored slot per kind and restore it when the kind returns to the record's kind. Files: internal/tui/integration_views.go (slotRows/slotValue), internal/tui/list_remove_views.go (integration edit).

title: TUI UX critique — Impeccable dual-agent synthesis (A+B) on internal/tui/
description:
# TUI UX critique synthesis (Impeccable dual-agent run on `internal/tui/`)

**Method:** dual-agent (A: `a8a4a03d7eb515ee3` · B: `a45828ce12c84bc07`)
**Target:** `internal/tui/` · **Slug:** `internal-tui`
**Platform:** Go / Bubble Tea TUI (text-only; Impeccable visual-pixel judgments mapped to text-cell equivalents)
**Date of run:** 2026-10-05

---

## Design Health Score

| # | Nielsen Heuristic | Score | Primary observation |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Visibility of system status | **3/4** | State line + pending banner + flash + live-tail during invite are strong. No live session-TTL countdown. |
| 2 | Match with real world | **3/4** | Operator vocabulary mostly natural; `KindSlot` / `generation` / `cap-id prefix` leak into help text. |
| 3 | User control & freedom | **2/4** | `esc` behavior inconsistent across views; "any key" dismisses the one-time-shown bearer on issue success. |
| 4 | Consistency & standards | **2/4** | 6+ picker idioms diverge on `space`/`a`/`n`/`other…`/backspace semantics. rc7l fixed Settings; the rest weren't converged. |
| 5 | Error prevention | **3/4** | Env-prefix collision warning + "passphrase matches admin passphrase" check + shared-identity ⚠ are excellent. |
| 6 | Recognition rather than recall | **2/4** | Owner glyphs (👤 🔒 p.) have no in-view legend; preset labels (`"1h (default — chat-friendly)"`) are a bright spot. |
| 7 | Flexibility & efficiency | **3/4** | j/k + arrows + 1-5 + single-letter + tab = real veteran paths. No fuzzy search with 50+ integrations. |
| 8 | Aesthetic & minimalist | **2/4** | Add-integration shows 11 rows + conditional pickers + hints + Save + error line + footer, often simultaneously. |
| 9 | Error recovery | **3/4** | `guardAdminAction` + osascript unlock + pending-fn stash is elegant. Loses a point: raw Go stderr surfaces to users. |
| 10 | Help & documentation | **2/4** | Footer-only. No `?`, no in-TUI concept docs. Admin/agent model is nowhere surfaced. |

**Mean: 2.5** — competent, inconsistent, dense.

**Design specificity:** domain-aware in the leaves (ownership glyphs, protected-grant passphrase sub-step, auto-reseal watcher, shared-identity warning), **generic at the trunk** (number menu, standard footer, muted state line, brand/muted/ok/danger palette). The admin-plane / agent-plane / operator-at-terminal / operator-at-phone split that is DOP's whole premise is nowhere visualized in the chrome.

---

## Cognitive load

- **Add-integration** = 11 rows with hidden-state branching (kind choice mutates subsequent step labels, no breadcrumb). A → "needs decomposition into quick-add + optional advanced-later." B → `integration_views.go` is 1548 LOC, split candidate. **Agree.**
- **Issue token** = step counter `0,1,2,3,4,100` with sentinel; user never sees "step N of M."
- **Bearer list** = 8 modes + two-phase grant-pick + modal transitions inferred from footer changes.
- **Muscle memory burden:** `a` means **four different things** across views (bulk-select / approve pending / show-all-revoked / toggle in grant-pick). B's step-literal scan (10 `step == N` sites, 7 in `views.go`) confirms the drift surface A described — same anti-pattern class as the rc6m bug.

---

## Emotional journey (peak-end)

| Flow | Start | Middle | End |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Admin init** | Calm | Anxious — 4 passphrase fields, "must be different" lands after typing | Mild dread if login step fails (bad landing) |
| **Add integration** | Curious | **Swamped** (11 rows, hidden-state branching, 6-field advanced sub-form) | Satisfying — probe summary + ✓ |
| **Issue token** | Energetic (env-prefix collision warning is 🤌) | Good | **High-stakes anxiety — "any key" dismisses bearer forever** |
| **Invite teammate** | Calm (fire-and-forget framing is honest) | Good (live tail transparent) | **Strongest end in the TUI** — exact read-aloud incantation + unambiguous enter/esc |

---

## Strengths (what to protect)

1. **Env-prefix collision warning** in the issue grant picker. Real-time, specific, prevents a silent "last write wins" footgun. Only exists because someone was burned.
2. **`guardAdminAction` + osascript unlock pattern** (rc7h). The pending-fn stash is a beautiful solution to "re-prompt mid-flow without blowing up the event loop."
3. **Invite waiting screen** (rc7o). Specific read-aloud incantation + unambiguous "enter closes / esc cancels." Peak collaborative moment.

---

## Priority issues (A findings; B provides mechanical corroboration)

### 1. Bearer loss on stray keypress — `views.go:512-517` (issue step 100)
"Any key dismisses" + "shown ONCE" + no re-copy = foot-gun. Needs explicit "I've saved it" confirm + `c` to re-copy before dismiss.
*A only — B's grep can't see this; it's behavioral.*

### 2. Picker idiom divergence
Settings view's rc7l rewrite documented the problem AND solved it only for Settings. The same sweep is overdue for `issueView`, `addIntegrationView`, `listView` grant-pick.
**B's evidence:** 29 ad-hoc `lipgloss.NewStyle` call sites outside the shared palette → the inconsistency extends from behavior to visual.

### 3. Add-integration maximalism
`integration_views.go` is 1548 LOC (B) hosting 11 rows + 4 conditional branches (A). Decompose into "quick add" + optional "advanced details" entry on the saved view.

### 4. Raw error surfacing
Operators see stripped Go stderr. B found **34 duplicated `if v.err != ""` render sites** → single `friendlyize(err)` helper would land once across all 34.

### 5. No live session-TTL countdown
State line is paint-time, not live. `guardAdminAction` exists specifically to cover for a status display that should have prevented the surprise in the first place.

---

## Mechanical findings (B-only, no A overlap)

- **Three files exceed 1500 LOC**: `list_remove_views.go` 2828, `views.go` 2275, `integration_views.go` 1548. Together 43% of the package.
- **2 `strings.Repeat(" ", …)` padding sites** in `tui.go:584, 670` — **direct violation of Contract 14** ("MUST use `lipgloss.Width()`" line 76-77). Localized, fixable in one patch.
- **10 `step == N` literal comparisons** concentrated in `views.go` (7 of 10). Any step shift re-triggers the rc6m bug. Named-constant sweep overdue.
- **2 Sprintf chains with ≥4 `%s`** at `views.go:2026` (bearer metadata status bar) and `list_remove_views.go:600` (token row) — formatting-helper candidates.
- **Totals:** 11,985 LOC in 19 files, 410 functions / 71 structs.

---

## Agreement vs divergence

| Finding | A | B | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Picker idiom divergence (behavior) | ✅ | — | A behavioral; B infrastructural (`lipgloss.NewStyle` sprawl) |
| Error surfacing is raw | ✅ | ✅ (34 sites) | Agree — fix is a shared helper |
| Hidden-state branching in step models | ✅ | ✅ (10 literal `step==N`) | Agree — same anti-pattern class as rc6m |
| Add-integration is maximalist | ✅ | ✅ (1548 LOC) | Agree |
| Three oversized files | — | ✅ | B-only; A didn't quantify |
| Bearer loss on stray keypress | ✅ | — | A-only; behavioral, not grep-able |
| Emotional journey valleys | ✅ | — | A-only |

**No false positives from B**; A didn't contradict any mechanical finding.

---

## Persona red flags

- **New team member joining** → waiting-screen hint ("open List → Team → Pending press `a`") is good, but no proactive banner on the next menu reopen that says "you have a pending approval."
- **Veteran admin issuing 100th token** → 5-page wizard for the common case. Needs a "quick issue" one-liner mode.
- **Operator with 50+ integrations** → add-grant integration picker has no search/filter; arrow-key only.

---

## Minor observations

- `looksLikePIN` and `extractRepinPin` scrape CLI stdout via string matching — fragile; a CLI output format change silently breaks TUI PIN display.
- `flashMessage` is one-shot; also used for guard-unlock status messages which the operator might blink past.
- Settings-view's rc7l docstring is a design document living in code. Great discipline — but only applies to that one view.
- Protection passphrase shows masked dots but no live min-chars feedback until enter.

---

## Three provocative questions

1. **Why is this a modal TUI at all?** The CLI is the source of truth; every TUI action shells out. What would a *dashboard* (persistent, live-updating list with inline action keys — no screen stack) feel like compared to the current wizard model?
2. **What's the TUI's answer to "I just made a mistake"?** No visible undo, no history. For a tool whose premise is "revoke is easy, so you can issue freely" — why is the TUI silent about the fact that revoke IS the undo?
3. **If a new team member watches a veteran admin use the TUI, can they learn by observation?** Most interactions are invisible single-keys (`a`, `r`, `d`, `+`, `p`). Should every keypress flash its name at the top-right for 500ms?

---

## Impeccable fit note

DOP TUI is terminal-only — Impeccable's detector returned zero findings (nothing to inspect in Go). The adapted mechanical scans (`go vet`, grep patterns, LOC footprint) + the design-director Assessment A carried the critique. Impeccable's visual-pixel discipline doesn't translate; its heuristic framework does.

---

## Suggested next-session menu

Pick one when resuming:

1. **Bearer-loss foot-gun** on issue-success "any key" (`views.go:512-517`)
2. **Picker idiom sweep** across remaining non-Settings views (`issueView`, `addIntegrationView`, `listView` grant-pick)
3. **Add-integration decomposition** (quick-add + advanced-later) — splits the 1548 LOC file naturally
4. **Shared `friendlyize(err)` helper** + 34 render-site rewrite
5. **Live session-TTL countdown** in the state line
close_reason: Addressed by v1.16.0 (PR #1): one frame + short footer + ? help on every screen, Esc one level back everywhere, picker idioms unified on one multi-select and one dense-form helper, Add integration decomposed into the Integration › Credential › Grant stepper with Normal/Advanced, step counters on wizards, issue-success bearer guard (enter / esc twice / c copy), vocabulary and glyph cleanup, stderr mapped through cliErr, screen-walk harness enforcing the layout rules. Remaining small gaps filed as separate issues.

title: TUI: a description cannot be cleared from the edit forms (CLI keeps existing on empty)
description: dop integration add merges into an existing integration and keeps the existing description when given an empty one (cmd/dop/integrationcmd.go, runIntegrationAdd merge rules), so the TUI edit form cannot clear a description. Options: an explicit --clear-description flag (or --description= sentinel) on the CLI, and the TUI sends it when the row is emptied. Same question for projects/tags if they follow the same rule; verify.

title: Align passphrase prompts: rename-token on a protected integration asks the approval passphrase, set-token does not
description: dop integration rename-token (v1.16.0) gates a protected integration with the owner check AND the approval passphrase because it rewrites grants; dop integration set-token only does the owner check (contract 18 says set-token must not re-prompt). Decide one rule for credential mutations on protected integrations and apply it to both (and to the TUI Rename action on the Credentials tab, which shows the passphrase step only in that case). Files: cmd/dop/integrationcmd.go, internal/tui/list_remove_views.go, contract 18.

Full proposal, mock README, GIF specs, where-the-cut-text-goes table and open questions: _rules/_plans/readme-tui-first-landing.md (local, gitignored). title: Switch vault — per-vault profiles (agents keep working across a switch)
description: Parked until real demand. Profiles = separate DOP roots (builds on DOP_HOME); agents route by bearer (search all profiles' capabilities/), never by the admin's current profile; each vault keeps its own daemon so switching doesn't lock the other. TUI: header vault chip + More › Vaults (switch/add/remove). First step if picked up: bearer routing across profiles in exec/env/use. Full design: _rules/_plans/vault-switch-profiles.md (local).
